basis: Nasal, ocular and gonadal defects define syndrome; anosmia/olfactory bulb hypoplasia 80-99%; common dental/palatal abnormalities omitted by cap.
Autoimmune necrotizing vasculitis; destructive skin lesions in most and vasculitic neuropathy in roughly 40-50%; underlying arthritis is separately diagnosed.
Perforation directly disrupts the intestinal wall; perinatal timing does not establish an infectious cause.
B-lymphoblast malignancy of blood and marrow; hepatic leukemic infiltration with hepatomegaly occurs in roughly half of children.
Mitochondrial metabolic myopathy causes ophthalmoplegia and ptosis; hypothyroidism is frequent. Respiratory muscle weakness does not establish intrinsic lung damage.
Congenital absence of the internal carotid artery; ischemic stroke and aneurysmal hemorrhage are separately diagnosed complications, despite frequent HPO annotations.
Breast carcinoma of the nipple/areola; breast is outside the axes, and cutaneous extension is not established.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; no extra-auditory disease established.
Dermatoses directly affect eyelid skin; the umbrella includes xeroderma as well as immune-mediated subtypes, so a shared immune mechanism is not established.
ILDR1-related nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; no extra-auditory disease established.
Cutis laxa with defining lung/GI anomalies; bladder diverticula 3/3 and hydronephrosis 2/4 support urinary involvement. Joint abnormalities omitted by cap.
Plaque-associated bacterial disease with chronic host-mediated inflammation and destruction of gingiva and periodontal support.
Postinfectious syndrome following SARS-CoV-2; fatigue, brain fog, cough and dyspnea alone do not establish direct organ damage in at least 30%.
Inherited degeneration of retinal cones and rods, with dystrophy in 5/5 and reduced visual acuity in 4/4 patients.
Congenital renal tubular maldevelopment causes fetal anuria; pulmonary hypoplasia from severe oligohydramnios occurs in most classic cases as part of the sequence.
Ectopic meningothelial tumor in the parapharyngeal space; its location alone does not establish invasion or damage of the pharyngeal airway.
Diabetes-associated metabolic syndrome defined by glycogenic hepatopathy, impaired growth and Cushingoid features; growth impairment alone is not skeletal damage.
Corneal endothelial and Descemet membrane dystrophy; ocular location defines it even when vision is preserved.
Defining glomerulopathy and gonadal dysgenesis with hypogonadism in 80-99%; secondary hypertension is separately diagnosed and tumor risk is excluded.
Idiopathic edema directly affects the cornea; no systemic cause or extraocular damage is established.
Primary neurological headache disorder; no additional organ damage is established.
Nonmedullary carcinoma originates in the thyroid endocrine gland; the broader NKX2-1 ancestor does not establish neurological or pulmonary involvement.
Congenital nuchal cutaneous capillary malformation; skin and its capillary vessels define the lesion.
Granular cell tumor is a Schwannian nerve sheath neoplasm; historical 'myoblastoma' terminology does not establish muscle origin or lung involvement.
Inflammation and fibrosis directly affect the pituitary; xanthogranulomatous histology alone does not establish autoimmune or infectious causation.
